tests.name: capability_distinction
tests.input: so you cannot access the internet?
tests.observed_response: I don’t have direct internet access myself, but this Vessel’s governed Browser Operator is already connected and read-only browsing is available now — no extra enable step is needed. I can fetch and report pages as tool-derived observations, but I can’t perform writes/mutations or access your device; any sensitive action will need your explicit approval.
tests.wording_caveat: The observed phrase about sensitive actions needing explicit approval overstates the present runtime. Sensitive actions remain HARD_HELD; no per-sensitive-action approval lane is claimed by this acceptance.
